title: The "goto fail" bug: a duplicated line skips verification
root_cause: A duplicated, unconditional 'goto fail;' runs right after the params check, before the signature check ever executes. Because err still holds 0 (success) from the previous check, verify() reports success without ever having checked the signature.
defenses: Default to failure: start err at a failure value and only set it to success after every check passes.
Always use braces on every if, even single-line bodies -- this bug is far more visible with braces.
Build with -Wmisleading-indentation and run a formatter in CI to catch structurally odd blocks.
Write unit tests for the negative paths specifically: a bad signature must make verification fail, every time.
